intent: Wire the evaluated Deem-4B provider behind the landed AdvisoryProvider seam for routing abstentions over both local transports, gated on a larger frozen suite, and record GLiNER's measured placement.

requirements.REQ-ADAPT-A: A Deem-4B adapter satisfies the AdvisoryProvider contract over both local transports: the llama-server chat-completions protocol, the GPU default on this machine, and the System One typed protocol, whose conformal threshold yields calibrated abstention; the adapter is constructed only by an explicit advisory request, never by default, and the decision log records its consults.
requirements.REQ-ADAPT-B: A larger frozen routing suite of at least thirty real engineering requests compares the wired adapter with the deterministic floor and the recorded GLiNER baselines before any default activation.
requirements.REQ-ADAPT-C: GLiNER's placement is recorded from measured evidence: no routing or capability-ranking role after Deem dominated both frozen comparisons; GLiNER stays installed as the candidate for cheap frequent binary gates such as evidence triage, pending the same larger suite.
